name: ranktitan-local-seo
description: Local SEO rank tracking and ranking heatmaps for Google Business Profiles.

interface.longDescription:
Rank Titan measures where a local business ranks in Google's map pack and reports those measurements in the conversation.

Two tools need no account at all: audit any business's Google Business Profile and see what it is missing, or find out who currently ranks for a local search, with ratings and review counts. Useful for a prospect, a competitor, or your own listing.

With a Rank Titan account you also reach your own data: the locations you manage, the map-pack position Rank Titan last measured for each tracked keyword and when it was taken, a full profile audit, the reviews still waiting for a reply, and the ability to publish a reply to Google from the conversation.

And the measurement local SEO is really about: a ranking grid. Pick a business and a search, and it measures position from 19 points spread across the surrounding area — which is how you find out you rank first at your own door and are invisible three miles away. It reports the average position, how much of the area holds a top-three spot, and which competitors hold the rest.

Rankings are stored measurements rather than a live scan, and every answer states when they were last taken. A grid is measured on request.

Sign-in uses the same Google account as Rank Titan, so there is no key to paste and no password for this plugin to see.
defaultPrompt: Who ranks on Google Maps for emergency plumber in Austin?
